{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {data['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")

# Check for duplicate patient_ids
print(f"Number of unique patient_ids: {data['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(data)}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_ids: {len(data) - data['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for assay_batch differences
print(f"Assay batch distribution: {data['assay_batch'].value_counts().to_dict()}")

# Check for sample_seq duplicates per patient_id
sample_seq_max = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
duplicate_patients = sample_seq_max[sample_seq_max > 1].index
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {len(duplicate_patients)}")

# Check severity distribution
print(f"Severity distribution: {data['severity'].value_counts().to_dict()}")"}
